SELECT A.FINAL_PRODG1 AS PRODG1, A.OPE_NO, A.SGS_EQP, SUM(A.WAFER_QTY) AS SGS_WIP FROM A1MFG.PR_WIP_SUM_LIST A JOIN A1MFG.PRODUCT_TECH_COMBINE B ON A.FINAL_PRODG1 = B.PRODG1 AND B.TECH =#{tech} AND B.PRODG1 =#{prodg} WHERE 1=1 AND A.SGS_VALUE IS NOT NULL AND OPE_NO =#{openo}
GROUP BY A.FINAL_PRODG1, A.OPE_NO, A.SGS_EQP ORDER BY LENGTH(A.SGS_EQP), A.SGS_EQP

SELECT A.CAST_ID , A.FINAL_PRODG1 AS PRODG1 , A.FINAL_PRODSPEC_ID AS PRODSPEC_ID , A.FAB , A.LOCATION_FAB , A.LOT_ID , A.MAINPD_ID , A.OPE_NO , C.EQP_G , 'PATH' AS PATH , A.WAFER_QTY , A.LOT_PRIORITY , A.SGS_VALUE AS SGS_EQP , A.SUB_LOT_TYPE , A.EQP_ID , A.XFER_STATE , A.STATE , CASE WHEN A.STATE='RUN' THEN ROUND((SYSDATE -A.CLAIM_TIME)*24,1) WHEN A.STATE='WAIT' THEN ROUND(A.WAIT_TIME,1) WHEN A.STATE='HOLD' THEN ROUND(A.HOLD_TIME,1) WHEN A.STATE='BANK' THEN ROUND(A.BANK_TIME,1) END AS DURATION , A.REMAIN_QTIME , A.TRIGGER_OP_NO , A.TARGET_OP_NO , TO_CHAR(A.TARGET_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS TARGET_TIME , A.HOLD_COMMENT , A.SAMPLING , A.REMAIN_LAYER FROM A1MFG.PR_WIP_SUM_LIST A JOIN A1MFG.PRODUCT_TECH_COMBINE B ON A.FINAL_PRODG1 = B.PRODG1 AND B.TECH =#{tech} AND B.TECH_FLAG ='Y' LEFT JOIN A1MFG.MST_FLOW_PRODG_ALL_FLOW C ON B.PRODG1 = C.PRODG1 AND A.OPE_NO = C.OPER_NO WHERE 1=1 AND A.OPE_NO =#{openo} AND A.SGS_EQP =#{sgseqp}

SELECT A.CAST_ID , A.FINAL_PRODG1 AS PRODG1 , A.FINAL_PRODSPEC_ID AS PRODSPEC_ID , A.FAB , A.LOCATION_FAB , A.LOT_ID , A.MAINPD_ID , A.OPE_NO , C.EQP_G , 'PATH' AS PATH , A.WAFER_QTY , A.LOT_PRIORITY , A.SGS_VALUE AS SGS_EQP , A.SUB_LOT_TYPE , A.EQP_ID , A.XFER_STATE , A.STATE , CASE WHEN A.STATE='RUN' THEN ROUND((SYSDATE -A.CLAIM_TIME)*24,1) WHEN A.STATE='WAIT' THEN ROUND(A.WAIT_TIME,1) WHEN A.STATE='HOLD' THEN ROUND(A.HOLD_TIME,1) WHEN A.STATE='BANK' THEN ROUND(A.BANK_TIME,1) END AS DURATION , A.REMAIN_QTIME , A.TRIGGER_OP_NO , A.TARGET_OP_NO , TO_CHAR(A.TARGET_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS TARGET_TIME , A.HOLD_COMMENT , A.SAMPLING , A.REMAIN_LAYER FROM A1MFG.PR_WIP_SUM_LIST A JOIN A1MFG.PRODUCT_TECH_COMBINE B ON A.FINAL_PRODG1 = B.PRODG1 AND B.TECH =#{tech} AND B.PRODG1 =#{prodg} LEFT JOIN A1MFG.MST_FLOW_PRODG_ALL_FLOW C ON B.PRODG1 = C.PRODG1 AND A.OPE_NO = C.OPER_NO WHERE 1=1 AND A.OPE_NO =#{openo} AND A.SGS_EQP =#{sgseqp}

mapper.select: SELECT A.TECH_LABEL, A.TECH_VALUE FROM( SELECT DISTINCT A.TECH AS TECH_LABEL, NVL(B.TECH_TEXT,A.TECH) AS TECH_VALUE, B.SEQ_NO FROM A1MFG.PRODUCT_TECH_COMBINE A LEFT JOIN A1MFG.MSTFLOW_TECH_MAINTAIN B ON A.TECH =B.TECH_TEXT )A ORDER BY A.SEQ_NO, A.TECH_VALUE

SELECT PRODG1_LABEL, PRODG1_VALUE FROM ( SELECT 'ALL' PRODG1_LABEL, 'all' PRODG1_VALUE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT PRODG1 AS PRODG1_LABEL, PRODG1 AS PRODG1_VALUE FROM A1MFG.PRODUCT_TECH_COMBINE WHERE PRODG1 IS NOT NULL AND TECH =#{tech} ) ORDER BY PRODG1_LABEL
